"Shadow and Fury" is an official trailer for released on 3 June 2024 to promote the beginning of the expansion's beta test. It is the first retail trailer created by the community content creator Hurricane. Narrated by Xal'atath, it showcases some of the main characters of the expansion and their internal struggles.

"Shadows Beneath" is a World of Warcraft: The War Within promotional cinematic released on 27 July 2024. It showcases various characters and locations from Khaz Algar. Several of the scenes were first shown in part in the release date announcement cinematic "Echoes of Azeroth", released the month prior.

Shadowspinner Azarak is a nerubian located with Shipwright Isaebela in the Silkwood Grotto on the Isle of Dorn. In Nightshade Hideout, he caught Lamplighter Kaerter and his adventuring companion in webs before leaving the cave with Isabella. Afterward, he was killed by the adventurer, along with Isaebela.

The Shake Shack promotion was a partnership with the United Kingdom branch of the fast-food franchise that was available for one week, between 14 November 2024 and 21 November 2024. New menu items included a "Horde Burger", "Alliance Fries", and "Xal'atath Shake" to promote expansion. The products were available at the Leicester Square, Mansion House, and Camden locations. The first 200 patrons across all locations would receive an exclusive tankard collectible, which were shipped to customers in January 2025. Customers that visited these locations could take photos of themselves with the food and tag official social media accounts to be entered into a lottery to win a customized The War Wit

Interacting with it will cause a floating torch to follow the player, granting the buff and creating a small aura of light that grants . Either buff is required to push back against the perpetual within the dungeon. If the torch bearer dies, it can be picked up from their corpse for a short time, otherwise it will reappear at the start of the dungeon.
